text: Dance is an art form that integrates the body and mind through movement. Dancers develop exceptional physical and mental abilities that involve various neurocognitive processes linked to embodied cognition. We propose that dancers’ primary trait representation is movement-actuated and relies on the extended mirror neuron system (eMNS).
source_label: Trait representation of embodied cognition in dancers pivoting on the extended mirror neuron system: a resting-state fMRI study
